latestVersion.changelog:
Unified Video Lyrics Online — v1.0.0

- Initial release enabling online AI-powered lyrics sync for music videos, with cloud-based 1080p exports.
- Upload a video and describe your desired results; timed lyrics and overlays generated automatically.
- Connects to remote GPU backend for fast server-side rendering (30-60 seconds typical).
- Credits-based access with seamless token acquisition for new users; up to 100 free credits.
- Supports various video/audio formats including MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and more.
- User can check export status, manage credits, preview timelines, and download finished videos through simple chat commands.
